_comment: Opt-in telemetry via a local OpenTelemetry Collector (RECOMMENDED)
_description: Sends gw traces + logs to a local OTel Collector that forwards to Dash0. The Dash0 token lives in the Collector config (see otel-collector.dash0.yaml), never in this committed file. Safe to commit.
_usage: 1) Run a Collector listening on http://localhost:4318. 2) Enable telemetry below. gw emits one span + log per command, each tagged with service.version so Dash0 can correlate deployments with errors.
